result.title: PAM-Mamba - Efficient Dense Action Detection using Mamba
result.summary: Dense action detection requires precisely localising multiple overlapping actions in long untrimmed videos. Transformer-based methods achieve strong accuracy but their $O(T^2)$ self-attention cost limits scalability. We present PAM-Mamba, a linear-time $O(T)$ architecture built on Mamba with a multi-branch temporal encoder. Gated Learnable Positional Encoding (GLPE) controls positional signal injection via a scalar gate initialised to zero, starting training without added positional signal. A Hub-and-Spoke Funnel extends the non-hierarchical multi-scale design of PAT with a direct residual from the original full-resolution input to each coarse branch, providing each coarse branch with a projection of the input features. Bi-TemBa (Bidirectional Temporal Mamba) first extracts local motion cues with a shallow Temporal Convolution Module, then applies a cascaded bidirectional Mamba scan; the backward pass refines the forward-scanned representation from the opposite direction, giving each temporal position access to context from both directions in linear time. Uncertainty-Based Mixup uses prediction entropy to guide the selection of mixup partners. Using the PAT evaluation implementation, we obtain 26.82 (Charades I3D), 34.59 (Charades CLIP), 46.56 (MultiTHUMOS I3D), and 46.92 mAP (MultiTHUMOS CLIP), with 26.1-27.9M parameters, 61-63% fewer than PAT.

AI.brief_summary: PAM-Mamba 提出基于 Mamba 的线性时间密集动作检测架构，包含多分支时序编码器、零初始化门控的可学习位置编码、先卷积后级联双向 Mamba 扫描的时序模块，以及用预测熵挑选 mixup 伙伴的策略，在 Charades 与 MultiTHUMOS 上以显著更少参数报告 mAP。
AI.relevance_reason: 其双向线性时间状态扫描与门控位置信号注入，可能可供核查 LVR 中跨位置上下文聚合方式及位置编码强度对 latent 表征的影响；但论文任务是视频动作定位，未涉及 VLM 推理或推理期 latent 状态，联系需较多核查。
